_note: Single source of truth for every number in the Stage 1 submission. Nulls and empty lists fail the gates, so nothing here survives as a placeholder, and a string in a numeric field fails too. Week 2 fills geometry, operating, performance, efficiency, power_by_radius, mass_envelope_g and sources. Week 3 fills pitch and packaging. Week 4 fills structure, mass_budget_g and the remaining results. Hard limits are checked against values RECOMPUTED from geometry and the mass lines, so an optimistic headline number achieves nothing. mass_envelope_g lines are {item, nominal_g, conservative_g, basis} with distinct item names. mass_budget_g lines are {item, mass_g, basis, refines}, where refines names the mass_envelope_g item this line came from, so week 4 continuity is checked per component and not only on the total. Aerodynamic power is bounded below by momentum theory over the declared momentum_area_m2, which may not exceed 2R times span, and the figure of merit that falls out has to be credible for a cyclorotor. thrust_sensitivity freezes in week 2 what raising thrust costs, and week 4 may only choose a row from it. Structural demands are derived: per-blade mass from the blade budget and blade count, rotor shaft torque from shaft power and speed, blade root bending from thrust per blade, lever arm and load factor.
